title: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
title_zh: EDGEGEN：通过合成边界案例生成提升超越“Happy Paths”的工具调用智能体
abstract_en: Tool-calling LLM agents are increasingly deployed in enterprise applications. However, effective evaluation and optimization require high-quality, diverse task datasets that are often difficult to obtain due to privacy and other constraints. Existing synthetic task generation methods often produce generic tasks that ignore an agent's underlying state or database and fail to reflect real-world usage diversity. We propose EdgeGen, a synthetic task generation framework that extracts compliance rules from an agent's specification and uses them to generate database-grounded edge-case tasks designed to violate these rules. When combined with existing synthetic data generation techniques, EdgeGen enables agent improvement through finetuning and harness optimization. The resulting pipeline forms a fully automated closed-loop system that requires no human annotation. Finetuning on data generated by EdgeGen yields a consistent mean progress improvement of 2 percent to 42 percent on tau2bench airline domain, while other baseline methods show degradation for some models. On the other hand, for harness optimization, our method shows a mean progress improvement of 10 percent and 30 percent over the human-curated and base harnesses, respectively, for the Gemma-4-e4b model.
abstract_zh: Tool-calling LLM agents 在企业应用中日益普及，但评测与优化依赖高质量、多样化任务数据，而隐私等限制使其难以获取。现有合成任务生成方法常产生泛化任务，忽略智能体底层状态或数据库，无法覆盖真实使用中的多样场景。本文提出 EdgeGen：从智能体规范中提取合规规则，并据此生成以数据库状态为基础、专门违反这些规则的边界案例任务。结合现有合成数据生成技术，EdgeGen 可通过微调和 harness 优化改进智能体，形成无需人工标注的全自动闭环流程。在 tau2bench airline domain 上，使用 EdgeGen 生成数据进行微调可稳定带来 2% 至 42% 的平均进步，而部分模型使用基线方法反而性能下降。在 harness 优化方面，相比人工构建 harness 和基础 harness，Gemma-4-e4b 分别取得 10% 和 30% 的平均进步。
key_points_zh: EdgeGen 从智能体规范中提取合规规则，生成专门违反规则的 edge-case 任务，突破仅覆盖正常流程的“Happy Paths”。
生成任务与数据库状态及智能体底层状态绑定，因而比通用合成任务更贴近真实企业使用场景。
该方法支持微调与 harness 优化，并构建无需人工标注的自动化闭环改进流程。
在 tau2bench airline domain 上，EdgeGen 微调带来 2% 至 42% 的平均进步；部分基线方法则导致部分模型退化。
在 harness 优化中，Gemma-4-e4b 相比人工构建和基础 harness 的平均进步分别为 10% 和 30%。

llm_assessment.comment: Edge-case generation grounded in agent state and compliance rules creates a practical closed loop for tool-agent training and harness optimization.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 基于Agent状态和合规规则生成边界案例，为工具型Agent训练与Harness优化建立了实用的闭环。
